title: Preregistration Does Not Improve the Transparent Evaluation of Severity in Popper’s Philosophy of Science or When Deviations are Allowed
reasoning: The paper is a philosophical and methodological critique of preregistration within the frameworks of Popper's and Mayo's philosophies of science. While it discusses epistemology, it does so as a branch of philosophy of science rather than as a component of evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethical values, and it does not involve LLMs.
